core_rules.trees: pass-through and non-opaque; axe felling; chop before mining supporting ground

rules.harvesting: Cutting a tree removes the connected trunk above the cut; one wood per removed trunk cell. Directional mining automatically uses the axe for trees.

protocol_context: Two architectures, three matched training seeds, 4M each; six-thread CPU trials with at most three concurrent jobs. Validation selects checkpoints; reserved test is used once.

paired_separate_minus_mlp.note: Three seeds are exploratory evidence, not a precise architecture ranking.

benchmarks.context: No training jobs active; active desktop; three repeats, same harness/seed protocol. Cross-version workload differences are not exact optimization speedups.

v4_vs_v3_workload_ratio.note: Different geometry/actions/trajectories; not a same-task optimization comparison.

verification.asan_ubsan: mechanics, fidelity and light suites passed
verification.pixel: 72 original assets audited; tree before/after, three armor variants and UI hit targets visually inspected
verification.api: Gym v4, 73 actions, 2961 observations, geometry/rules queries and v3 checkpoint rejection passed

local_assembly_constants.source: Read from installed Terraria.exe with tools/terraria_fidelity_audit.py; assembly SHA256 is in asset_audit.

excluded_provisional_runs.reason: Pre-release v4 half-defense rounding was corrected before final trials; no reserved test used.
excluded_provisional_runs.snapshot: provisional/v4; never load these checkpoints into the final v4 rules

selection.criterion: highest validation mean; ties: lower death rate, fewer steps, run name
selection.note: Selection frozen before test. The reserved split is now consumed; do not tune against its results.

asset_audit.note: Hashes audit originals, not pixel equivalence of the simplified SDL renderer. IL constants were manually inspected; this script does not re-decompile them.
